北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴热，体感 33℃。防晒补水，别中暑哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and hot, feels like 33℃. Stay hydrated and sun-protected!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 36℃，酷热难耐！多喝水，注意防暑降温。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels like 36℃, extremely hot! Drink more water and prevent heatstroke.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 34℃ 且湿度高。小心闷热，保持清爽。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels like 34℃ with high humidity. Stay cool and comfortable.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州大雨，风力 4级。外出记得带伞，注意出行安全哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has heavy rain and 4-grade wind. Take an umbrella and travel safely!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，风力 5级。出门注意大风，小心安全。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with strong 5-grade wind. Watch out for strong gusts outside.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云炎热，体感 34℃。多补充水分，谨防中暑哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and hot, feels like 34℃. Hydrate well to avoid heatstroke.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阵雨，湿度 100%。出门带伞，体感微凉别着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has showers and 100% humidity. Take an umbrella, it feels a bit cool.
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 26℃ 左右。天气舒适，出门散散心吧！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, around 26℃. The weather is pleasant, enjoy your day!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雨，气温 24℃。雨势较大，请注意防雨保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has heavy rain, 24℃. Heavy downpour, stay dry and warm.
武汉.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，气温 29℃。阳光正好，出门记得防晒哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and 29℃. Beautiful sunshine, remember sun protection!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 29℃。天气闷热，多喝水注意散热。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels like 29℃. It's muggy, stay hydrated and cool.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，气温 22℃，湿度 90%。体感凉爽，谨防着凉。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is overcast, 22℃ with 90% humidity. Feels cool, avoid catching a cold.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，气温 28℃。风力 4级，出门注意防风哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, 28℃ with 4-grade wind. Watch out for the wind outside.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 19℃。有点凉，出门添件衣服吧。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast, feels like 19℃. It's a bit cool, wear an extra layer.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 32℃。天气炎热，注意防暑降温。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 32℃. It's hot, stay cool and prevent heatstroke.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾弥漫，湿度 90%。能见度低，出行请注意安全。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy with 90% humidity. Low visibility, please travel safely.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连大雾，风力 5级。能见度差，注意出行安全哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy with 5-grade wind. Poor visibility, please travel safely.
